title: Bawan Allah Mai Girma
intro: Kana jin raɗa na wani mutum daga zamanin da, bawan Allah wanda aka ɗaga shi zuwa matsayi mafi girma a kan talakawa. An san wannan mutum da haƙuri mai ƙarfi da gaskiya, kuma an aika shi zuwa ga mutanen da suka juya baya ga saƙon. Wanene wannan ruhi mai ɗaukaka?
clues: Allah ya zaɓe ni a matsayin annabi kuma an ambace ni a cikin Alƙur'ani Mai Tsarki.
An san ni da haƙuri da gaskiya, halaye da Allah ya yaba.
Na kira mutanena su bauta wa Allah ɗaya, amma mutane da yawa sun ƙi ni.
Allah ya ɗaukaka matsayi na, kuma ya ba ni babban matsayi.
Sau da yawa ana ambace ni tare da sauran annabawa kamar Ismail da Dhul-Kifl.
Allah yana cewa game da ni: 'Kuma muka ɗaukaka shi zuwa matsayi mai girma.' (19:57)

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ya kira mutane zuwa ga bauta wa Allah
An gwada shi da rashin lafiya mai tsanani
trial.answer: Ya kira mutane zuwa ga bauta wa Allah

verse: And We raised him to a high station. (19:57)
